items.name: Game-Of-The-Goose
items.description: Board game for two or more players. Each player rolls a die and advances his piece through a snail-shaped board with 63 squares, with drawings. Depending on the square in which it falls, you can advance or on the contrary go back, and in some of them a punishment or a prize is indicated.
